bugs_found: load_yaml_file can return non-dict or raise yaml.YAMLError; contract-presence, contract-validate, floats-check and all can crash instead of returning configuration error for malformed/empty .banking-profile
cmd_review_validate and cmd_contract_validate load schema JSON without handling FileNotFoundError/JSONDecodeError, causing uncaught crashes instead of documented exit code 2
review directory fallback uses unsanitized args.branch, allowing path traversal outside .claude/reviews via branch values like ../..
contract-presence validates every Python def in a file by matching contract name only, so one contract block with a reused function name can satisfy multiple functions/classes incorrectly
unsupported language warning in contract-presence reports only the first extension because of sorted(... )[:1], hiding skipped sensitive files for other extensions
